### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/position (route, a path literal in acceptanceCriteria))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **55** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **149** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7c70f91ce1910553ae1be4b19297011ae6ad04c0` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `114073642c6b6b974b468fd5201059bc2b1bc682` — the merge of head `4b0074c42c1a02c14f1be76b063706463b41e0bc` into base `7c70f91ce1910553ae1be4b19297011ae6ad04c0`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 114073642c6b6b974b468fd5201059bc2b1bc682 && git checkout 114073642c6b6b974b468fd5201059bc2b1bc682
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7c70f91ce1910553ae1be4b19297011ae6ad04c0 4b0074c42c1a02c14f1be76b063706463b41e0bc && git checkout -B drift-repro 7c70f91ce1910553ae1be4b19297011ae6ad04c0 && git merge --no-ff 4b0074c42c1a02c14f1be76b063706463b41e0bc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7c70f91ce1910553ae1be4b19297011ae6ad04c0
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7c70f91ce1910553ae1be4b19297011ae6ad04c0` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1a70ed572c398971bbb57877b1eb65e7fcf6dd0d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.position-grant-via-name-retired.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/managedEnvironmentUsers.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/managedEnvironmentUsers-13330.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PositionGrantCells.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.positionGrants-25333.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewIdentity.tsx, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.listInclude-25333.test.ts + .changeset/26022-retire-position-grant-via-name.md, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts (describePositionGrants, :3516-3577), packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/describe-position-grants.test.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/README.md, packages/spec/src/migrations/types.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.visibility-alias-fold-unexported.ts (the TS/API-surface precedent), packages/spec/src/migrations/semantic-relevance.test.ts, packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md, .changeset/24757-retire-position-name-fold.md, .changeset/config.json, packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/index.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/package.json

Inputs: card #26022 (body and all seven comments, through the dev report 6431841169), PR #26398 (body, 12-file list, both comments, no review comments, no reviews), the net diff against `main` (439 lines, +107/-96), and the check-runs on the head, read 2026-10-27T02:01:25Z. Base-side code was read on the local checkout at `origin/main` 13136f73 (the CI base abb90460 is an ancestor; the head commit is not present locally, so the head side is the diff itself). Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`PositionGrantVia` loses `'name'` — a public-surface narrowing, named right.** `@objectstack/spec/contracts` publishes the type; it types `PositionGrantSummary.permissionSets[].via` on `ISecurityService.describePositionGrants`. The only producer on `main` is `security-plugin.ts` `describePositionGrants` (:3549-3577), which pushes `{ name, via: 'definition' }` and nothing else, pinned by `describe-position-grants.test.ts:141` (every served `via` is `'definition'`). So after the diff the type describes exactly the served accept set. `api-surface/contracts.json` records `PositionGrantVia (type)` by name only, so the snapshot does not move — the dev's "api-surface unchanged" reading is right, and `check:api-surface` is structurally blind to this narrowing, which is why the changeset and the D3 entry are the carriers.
2. **Nothing emits or reads `via: 'name'` after the diff.** Measured on the base tree (origin/main 13136f73) minus the hunks: every code hit for `via: 'name'`, `via === 'name'`, `'definition' | 'name'`, `grants.byName` and `byNameHint` is inside the diff's own removals. What survives is prose only: `security-plugin.ts:3535-3536` ("the contract's `'name'` member is no longer served" — stale once the member is gone; see ③), `describe-position-grants.test.ts:13` and `:140` ("`via: 'name'` is never served" — still a true sentence), the pending `.changeset/24757-retire-position-name-fold.md` ("retired separately in #26022" — accurate as a record), and ADR-0138's two historical mentions of the fold. `POSITION_NAME_FOLD_EVENT` and the warning are #24757's runtime half, outside this card. `content/docs`, `apps/docs` and `skills` carry no mention of the badge, the keys or the member; the docs-drift row is a RELEASE-OWNED page, read-only by rule.
3. **REST pass-through — docblock only, right.** The `meta-item-read-gate.ts` hunk rewrites two comment lines on `describeMetaPositionList`; the code places the security service's answer and reads no `via`. No behaviour moves.
4. **`PositionGrantCells.tsx` — right.** `PositionGrantedSet.via` narrows to `'definition'`, `readGrantedSets` keeps only `via === 'definition'`, the badge text, its `span` and the `title` go. One shift to notice: the old docblock promised a by-name grant was "marked, never hidden"; the new filter hides any entry whose `via` is not `'definition'`. Only a server older than #26064 could serve one, the console and the spec are in the same fixed changeset group (`.changeset/config.json`), and the filter already dropped unknown values before this diff, so this is consistent, not a regression.
5. **`managedEnvironmentUsers.tsx` — the client fold retired, the unknown-stays-unknown rule kept.** The `ensureType('permission')` read, `setNames`, `catalogueRead` and `PositionRegistrySource.getTypeStatus` served only the fold: the repo-wide grep finds no other reader of `getTypeStatus` through `PositionRegistrySource`, and `objectViewIdentity.tsx:62` is the single `UserGrantLoader` construction site, whose `getTypeStatus` line the diff drops. After the diff a failed `ensureType('position')` answers `[]`, every held position then has `sets === undefined`, and the user lands in `uncertain` — never "not authorized" — exactly as the rewritten docblock says. The 13330 pin is inverted (a `closer` holder reads `baseline-only`, a `sales_rep` holder `beyond-baseline`, the registry asked only for `position`); the "catalogue cannot be read" case is deleted because the read it covered no longer exists, so there is no surviving assertion to duplicate (see ③).
6. **The two i18n keys are not a published surface.** `engine.position.grants.byName` / `byNameHint` leave both `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` and `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` with no reader left. `t` leaves the metadata-admin barrel as `translateMetadataAdmin`, but `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` does not re-export it and `package.json` `exports` names dist leaves none of which is `i18n`; a missing key echoes the key by design. Naming them in the changeset is informative, and they rightly carry no semver weight.
7. **Fixture respellings — right.** The runtime parity double (:347, :679) and the data-objectstack listInclude fixture (:38) served `{ name: 'sales_manager', via: 'name' }`; both now serve `{ name: 'forecasting', via: 'definition' }`, keeping each pin's shape (two positions, distinct sets) while serving only a value the type still admits.
8. **ADR-0087 — the D3 entry is registered the way the registry asks.** `entries/semantic/18.position-grant-via-name-retired.ts` carries id `position-grant-via-name-retired`, so the filename follows the rule the generator enforces (the protocol major, a dot, then the id); there is no index to edit (the README: the directory listing is the index; `gen:migration-registry` runs on install, build, typecheck and test). The literal matches `SemanticMigration` and mirrors the TS/API-surface precedent `18.visibility-alias-fold-unexported.ts`; it omits `conversionIds` and `relevantWhen`, which is right — the type has no stored row and no stack key to convert or to ask about, and `semantic-relevance.test.ts` enumerates only entries that carry a question. No D2 conversion is owed for the same reason. The alternative disposition `not-required (type-surface-only ...)` is closed to this PR by its predicate 2 (no spec diff) since the diff touches `packages/spec/src`, so `registered` is the one fitting disposition, and the id is new in this diff (gate rules R3/R4 satisfied). The entry leaves ADR-0087, ADR-0131 D3/D4 and ADR-0049 ids in the code. The retirement follows #13419 ruling B as the card and triage record it; it aligns with ADR-0131 rather than reversing a recorded decision, so no new ADR is owed.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset** `.changeset/26022-retire-position-grant-via-name.md`: `@objectstack/spec: patch`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`, both in the fixed group. Body carries `**BREAKING**`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, a `Ruling-ref:` line, the FROM-to-TO migration (TS2367 on a `'name'` comparison; delete the branch; name the set in `permissionSets`), and exactly one ADR-0087 marker reading `registered position-grant-via-name-retired` (spelled as the HTML comment the gate reads).
- **PR body** lines 4-5: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` — byte-identical to the changeset and to the claim amendment 6430877545. The title `feat(spec)!:` carries the `!`; the BREAKING banner sits where the gate reads it, the changeset body, and the body's 维护者速读 states the compile break in prose.
- **Level judged right.** `PositionGrantVia` is not authorable: no Zod schema, no `authorable-surface` shard, no stack key — it types a served description. So `Metadata-protocol: none` is the right kind, and under ruling A (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs:910-919`) `none` grades every introduced entry `patch`, while a non-protocol narrowing "ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition unchanged" — which is what this changeset does. The `(narrowing)` arm is the ADR-0087 breaking signal and the contract-review face; both are present. The #25608 precedent took `minor` with `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` because it retired a Zod model an author writes against; the difference is the kind, not a contradiction.
- `@objectstack/rest` (two docblock lines), `@objectstack/runtime` and `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (test files only) move without a changeset entry; none publishes a behaviour or a type change. `Check Changeset` concluded success at 01:58:24Z.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Author and provenance.** PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; head repo equals base repo (not a fork); assignee `os-support-ai` mirrors the card; draft, `auto_merge` null, `mergeable_state` blocked — the expected state before this record. Branch `claude/project-thread-9lmgya` instead of `claude/issue-26022-...`: the claim 6430837212 records why (the platform assigns the thread's branch), and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` concluded success.
- **Check-runs at 2026-10-27T02:01:25Z** — 40 runs: 22 completed (16 success, 6 skipped by the fast-set filter: Build Docs, the three dogfood jobs, Temporal Conformance, the opt-in harnesses), 18 `in_progress`. Of the required contexts, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is success; `Build Core`, `Test Core (1-8)`, the `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` lanes are in progress; `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` had not appeared yet (`Build UI Deps` in progress). `in_progress` is not a pass: this record judges the diff, and landing still waits on the required set per §7.
- **Dev deviations, all five accepted by the record.** (1) Clause line `no (narrowing)` — the seat's amendment 6430877545 accepted it. (2) Three files beyond the first claim — the same amendment accepted them, and ① confirms each (the one caller, two fixtures). (3) Local app-shell run narrowed to 182 files — CI's UI jobs carry the rest, pending above. (4) Both entries `patch` — judged right in ②. (5) No reviewer request — this record is the review. `open_questions` is empty.
- **The dogfood reds are not this diff's.** The ten failures count text in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (`REST_SERVER_FILE`, authz-conformance :51; probe :95) and `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts` (:210). The diff touches neither path, and its only rest hunk is two comment lines in `meta-item-read-gate.ts`, a file the matrices name only inside prose strings (`enforcement:`, `enforcedBy:`) and never count. From the diff alone, nothing in it can move those counts: main-red, as the dev reports it (`git diff origin/main` empty on the three paths). Under the two-speeds rule the PR's dogfood jobs are skipped and the red lives in `main`'s full battery; it is the lane's to file under the main-red convention, which the dev's out-of-scope finding (class a) hands the seat. No arming while it stands.
- **Stale docblock, `security-plugin.ts:3535-3536`**, "the contract's `'name'` member is no longer served": after this diff the member does not exist, so the sentence goes stale. Left out because PR #26337 holds that file; carried in the PR's Acceptance notes with the seat as carrier. Accepted — a comment, no behaviour, and the single-writer rule decides it. The sibling prose at `describe-position-grants.test.ts:13` and `:140` stays true and needs nothing.
- **The deleted test case** (`a position held while the permission-set catalogue cannot be read leaves its user unknown`) pinned a read this diff removes; the invariant it protected — a failed registry read leaves the user unknown — is still pinned by the surviving `a position the registry does not define leaves its user unknown` case and by the `sets === undefined` branch. Not a deletion of a live pin.
- **Pending stock `.changeset/24757-retire-position-name-fold.md`** says the member is "retired separately in #26022; until then the value is published but never served" — correct as a record of that change; rightly untouched.
- **Docs-drift bot**: the one flagged page is `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`, RELEASE-OWNED and read-only; the release compiles this changeset and the D3 entry. Nothing is owed here.
- No governed surface in the file list; 203 changed lines, under the 3,000 threshold.
